name: Greenland
description: The world's largest island that is not a continent, located between the Arctic and Atlantic oceans. Approximately 80% of its surface is covered by the Greenland ice sheet.

name: New Guinea
description: The world's second-largest island, located in the southwestern Pacific Ocean. Divided between Indonesia's western provinces and the independent state of Papua New Guinea in the east.

name: Borneo
description: The third-largest island in the world and the largest in Asia, politically divided among three countries: Malaysia (Sabah and Sarawak), Brunei, and Indonesia (Kalimantan). Home to one of the oldest rainforests on Earth.

name: Madagascar
description: An island country off the southeastern coast of Africa, the world's fourth-largest island. Renowned for its unique biodiversity, with over 90% of its wildlife found nowhere else on Earth (including lemurs).

name: Baffin Island
description: The largest island in Canada and the fifth-largest island in the world, located in the Canadian territory of Nunavut in the Arctic Archipelago.

name: Sumatra
description: A major island in western Indonesia, the sixth-largest island in the world. Straddles the equator and is known for its rugged volcanic Barisan Mountains, tropical rainforests, and wildlife such as the Sumatran tiger.

name: Honshu
description: The main and largest island of Japan, the seventh-largest island in the world and the second-most populous after Java. Home to Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, and Mount Fuji.

name: Great Britain
description: The largest island in Europe and the ninth-largest in the world, comprising the nations of England, Scotland, and Wales, separated from continental Europe by the English Channel.
